probes.name: richai_integration
probes.body:
Reseller API API Reference AI Agents Integration Changelog

AI Agents Integration

Drop this spec into your agentic coder — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Aider, anything that operates inside your repo. It reads your codebase, detects the stack, writes the integration, runs the verification curls, and reports back. No questions asked.

How to use it

  1. Get your API key — message the Telegram bot, run /become_reseller, wait for approval. You'll be DM'd the key once.
  2. Open your project in your agentic coder.
  3. Confirm the Base URL below matches where the API will live in production.
  4. Copy prompt, paste it as your first message. The agent will read the repo, ship the integration, and run the included curl checks.

What people use this for

Webstore Shopify, WooCommerce, or a custom storefront — your customer pays you, the integration places an order on us and ships the codes to them.

Telegram bot Your own bot resells our products — your customers run /buy, your bot debits its balance with us, codes are delivered through your bot.

The prompt below is regenerated whenever you change this. Use whatever public URL your AI agent will be able to reach.

View OpenAPI JSON Copied to clipboard

Tips

  • Paste the prompt as the first message in a fresh session — let the agent build context from the repo on its own.
  • Put RESELLER_API_KEY in your project's .env (or whatever secret convention the repo already uses) before you start, so the verification curls can run.
  • If the agent stops to ask which stack you're on, point it at your package.json / pyproject.toml — that's enough.
  • The full schema lives at openapi.json. The agent can fetch it directly for any detail this spec doesn't cover.
